actions.name: schedule_set
actions.description: Create or update a schedule (id absent = generate): a one-shot or cron trigger that either publishes an event or dispatches a kernel-routed action when it fires. The action runs later, unattended, without the caller present.

id.description: Client-supplied schedule id (also the database key suffix). Absent = generated monotonic id. Re-using an id replaces the whole schedule and resets its fire state.

name.description: Display name echoed in fired events. Optional.

enabled.description: Disabled schedules persist but never fire.

at_ms.description: Fire at this unix-milliseconds instant. Exactly one of at_ms/delay_ms.

delay_ms.description: Fire this many ms after the call; resolved to an absolute at_ms at set time. Exactly one of at_ms/delay_ms.

once.description: One-shot trigger. Required unless cron is given; exactly one of once/cron.

expr.description: Standard 5-field crontab expression or 6-field with seconds (e.g. '*/5 * * * *', '0 30 9 * * MON'). Validated up front.

tz_offset_min.description: Fixed UTC offset in minutes the expression evaluates in; 0 = UTC. Ignored when tz is set.

tz.description: IANA timezone e.g. Europe/Berlin. When set, tz_offset_min is ignored and DST is handled correctly.

cron.description: Recurring trigger. Required unless once is given; exactly one of once/cron.

payload.description: Arbitrary JSON carried in the fired event (≤64 KiB serialized). Optional.

event.description: Fire kind: publish plugin.scheduler.fired. Required unless action is given; exactly one of event/action.

name.description: Action name routed by the kernel to whichever plugin serves it (globally unique).

params.description: JSON params for the action (≤64 KiB serialized). Optional.

action.description: Fire kind: kernel-routed action call. Required unless event is given; exactly one of event/action.

created.description: True when a new schedule was created rather than an existing id replaced.

actions.name: schedule_get
actions.description: Fetch one schedule by id with its trigger and fire kind. Read-only.

actions.name: schedule_list
actions.description: List schedules with limit/offset paging. Read-only.

schedules.description: Sorted by next_fire_ms ascending; done/disabled (no pending fire) last.

actions.name: schedule_delete
actions.description: Delete a schedule by id. Irreversible, and it silently stops whatever was relying on it from firing.

deleted.description: True only when the schedule existed and was removed.

at_ms.description: Absolute unix-ms fire time (delay_ms requests are resolved at set time).

tz_offset_min.description: Fixed UTC offset in minutes; 0 = UTC. Ignored when tz is set.

name.description: Kernel-routed action name; the provider is whichever plugin serves it.

params.description: JSON params for the dispatched call.

last_fired_ms.description: Scheduled instant of the most recent fire; null until the first fire.

last_error.description: Diagnostics from the latest failed action dispatch; null otherwise.

SCHEDULER_PLUGIN_DB_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for each database IPC call and each dispatched scheduled action.

SCHEDULER_PLUGIN_SCAN_SECS.description: Schedule scan interval in seconds; bounds firing precision. 0 disables scanning entirely.
